name: Friction-Reducing Reassurances
blueprintProse:
Positioned directly adjacent to conversion inputs, this micro-unit uses a brief 4 to 12 words to neutralize last-minute hesitation. It covers three key reassurances: confirming trial freedom (33%), removing credit card requirements (33%), and stating setup brevity (34%). 
This unit addresses ambiguity aversion and pre-conversion micro-anxiety. Users at the point of action often worry about hidden financial commitments or complex onboarding workflows. Placing clear reassurances adjacent to conversion triggers defuses perceived risk and preserves momentum.
frontLine: Trial freedom 33 · Card requirement 33 · Setup brevity 34
template: [No Credit Card Required] • [X-Day Zero-Risk Trial] • [Setup in Under X Minutes]

example.bland: Terms and conditions apply. Free trial.
example.optimized: 14-day free sandbox • No credit card required • Deploy with 1 line of bash.
